_comment: Questions a podcast host asks before they know who to invite. None names Greg Swierad. Keep the set fixed so runs stay comparable; when a question changes, give it a new id instead of editing the old one. Themes: guest = 'who should I invite', expert = 'who knows about X', info = a how-to question the topic pages could be cited for. `branded: true` rows are controls (does the model describe Greg correctly?) and are left out of the share.
